name: com.ayskilllab/tenders
title: AY Tenders
description: Free, read-only search of public tenders from TED, UK, Ireland and US federal, in seven sectors.

tools.name: search_open_tenders
tools.description: Open calls for bids in our seven sectors, nearest deadline first. Needs at least one of query, sector, country or closes_within_days: there is no list of everything. Up to 10 rows an answer and 3 pages; 300 rows a day per address. Each row has the official notice (official_url) and our page (page_url) when we have one.

query.description: Words in the title or the buyer's name, in the notice's language.

sector.description: it_services = IT systems & software, cybersecurity = Cybersecurity, medical_devices = Medical devices & pharmaceuticals, civil_works = Civil works & construction, energy_solar = Energy, solar & efficiency, cleaning_environment = Cleaning, environment & waste, events_marketing = Events, exhibitions & marketing.

country.description: The buyer's country, two letters (GB, DE, US...).

region.description: uk, us, or eu (every other country).

closes_within_days.description: Only tenders whose deadline is in this many days.

page.description: Page of results, from 1; ten rows a page.

tools.name: get_tender
tools.description: One notice's page: title, buyer, country, stage and notice type, estimated value, published date, deadline, CPV, NAICS and PSC codes, place of performance where the notice states one, and the official notice. Counts as one row.

id.description: An id a search returned, such as ted-768295-2026, or the page address.

tools.name: expiring_contracts
tools.description: Contracts in our seven sectors whose period ends in the coming months (3 unless you say, 12 at most), from UK award notices, Irish award dates plus the stated duration (an estimate, marked so) and USAspending. A contract ending is often re-tendered, but not always. Up to 10 rows an answer and 3 pages; 300 rows a day per address.

region.description: uk, ie (Ireland) or us. Leave it out for all three.

months_ahead.description: Contracts ending within this many months; 3 unless you say.

sector.description: it_services = IT systems & software, cybersecurity = Cybersecurity, medical_devices = Medical devices & pharmaceuticals, civil_works = Civil works & construction, energy_solar = Energy, solar & efficiency, cleaning_environment = Cleaning, environment & waste, events_marketing = Events, exhibitions & marketing.

query.description: Words in the title or the buyer's name.

page.description: Page of results, from 1; ten rows a page.
